events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Chaperone refs and frontend checkout
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git grep -in chaperone -- app/src/components | head; echo ---; ls ~/tantra-frontend-v2 2>&1 | head; cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 2>/dev/null && git status -sb | head -5 && git log --oneline -3; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone frontend repo on adi-new-ui and locate Calendly refs
events.input: $ ls -la ~/tantra-frontend-v2 | head; cd /tmp && rm -rf t072-fe && gh repo clone Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 t072-fe -- -b adi-new-ui -q 2>&1 | tail -3; cd t072-fe && git log --oneline -3 && ls src/app/enterprise && grep -rn "CALENDLY\|applyOwnerCorrections\|calendly" src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx -l
